### Bible Pathway - January 26
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-jan-26-2013.html
Passage: Exodus 27:1
Points:
- The bronze altar was the designated place where judgment on sin was carried out through an innocent substitute.
- Placing hands on the sacrificial animal represented the transfer of the worshiper's guilt.
- The Old Testament altar and sacrifices pointed forward as types and shadows of Jesus Christ.
- Believers receive lasting peace knowing their sin was fully judged and forgiven through Christ's sacrifice.
